analysis: All four units are documentation-only: docs/architecture/inference.md (head text, lines 401-1112) and docs/developer/serving-performance-qualification.md (a date bump and a new paragraph separating startup calibration from profile qualification). No source, wire protocol, crypto, authorization or deployment settings change, and the docs introduce no new attack surface. Their content is consistent with the T-041 cache posture. They repeat that MiMo and Qwen complete-prefix paths use encrypted SSD, and that text-only complete checkpoints bind the exact store, with SSD persistence behind DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE and no change to the TTL, HMAC naming or salt scoping. Documentation in inference.md describes the Standalone MTP/idle-upgrade drain, the typical-acceptance MTP default for sampled rows (approximate output, an explicit exact opt-out), the media caps, and the MiMo memory accounting. These are descriptions of behavior rather than control changes. Nothing found weakens TB-002, TB-003, TB-007 or TB-011, and the T-053 and T-054 boundaries are untouched. Coverage limit: the PR changes only docs, so the claims about code behavior, such as the typical-acceptance default and MemoryBackedVideoAsset not writing to disk, were not checked against code, which was not supplied. The no-disk-write claim for MemoryBackedVideoAsset relates to T-050 (inline video temp-file exposure) and would warrant verification if the code is reviewed. The file df7b812fb7e912bf:0 carried metadata only, with no content change.
